title: Chapter 54 Contract Scroll
content:
Chapter 54 Contract Scroll

"Contract scroll?" Guliji was a little confused. She had been thinking about finding a chance to escape.

She wanted to regret it at this time, but she had to bow her head under the eaves. She was a little bit stuck.

Wang Shuo did not give them too much time to think.

"Now it's time to make a choice."

Wang Shuo decided to start with the few people with the least courage.

"Roger, if you agree with my proposal, then come to the front and sign a vow contract with me." Wang Shuo turned his head and looked at him, giving an ultimatum.

Although his tone was flat, his eyes were sharp and compelling.

When Roger was caught by Wang Shuo, he wet his pants, and hid under the table the whole time, without any resistance.

He walked out tremblingly, knowing that he could not escape this disaster, he had accepted his fate and handed over the supplies in his backpack directly.

A heart of shelter, a soul crystal, and 98 energy crystals.

"That's about right."

Then he gave him a contract with the oath already written on it. He only needed to read it and then put his fingerprint on it.

The system is everywhere, and the form of concluding a contract is not complicated.

"I, Roger, voluntarily join Wana Village, hand over all materials, and obey the orders of Lord ID: SAC5678 Wang Shuo until the battle for the village order ends. At that time, Lord Wang Shuo will give me a heart of shelter and return my freedom."

After saying that, he put his fingerprint on it.

Wang Shuo also put his fingerprint on it, and the contract took effect.

At this time, Roger's panel attributes changed, showing that he is now a villager of Wana Village, and he also has a loyalty attribute.

Wang Shuo also noticed this phenomenon. He looked at the three brothers of the Gong family, who also had a loyalty attribute, but it showed: loyalty 100/100.

And Roger's loyalty, under the guarantee of the contract, also reached 78/100.

The contract scroll is not a disposable item, but can be reused.

With Roger as the first example, the other named players also signed the contract smoothly and joined Wana Village.

Among them, there was a player who concealed the items in his system space. When the contract came into effect, he was directly wiped out by the system.

At this time, everyone was terrified when they saw the system wipe out the player for the first time.

Wang Shuo was no exception. It seems that everything related to the system rules should be treated with caution in the future.

With the previous experience of the system erasing the player, even the most reluctant Guliji did not resist and joined Wana Village.

So far, Wang Shuo has harvested many precious resources.

[Soul Crystal +11, Energy Crystal +4700, Gold Coin +1W, Silver Key +1]

Wang Shuo was satisfied after seeing these things. Compared with the value of these things, the basic materials before were not worth mentioning.

After everyone joined Wana Village, Wang Shuo enthusiastically distributed food to everyone.

Because of the existence of loyalty, Wang Shuo still has to try his best to build a good relationship with these players, no, it should be said that the people, build a good relationship.

On the temporary table, Wang Shuo directly took out some previously purchased drinks and raised his glass to everyone, saying: "We are now a family. I hope everyone can put aside the past grudges, work together, and seek a chance to survive in this chaotic place."

"I hope everyone can understand what I did before. After all, this is the darkest moment of human nature. Every stranger may be your enemy, and I have no choice."

"After drinking this glass of wine, we are brothers and sisters."

Wang Shuo took the lead in drinking it, and then everyone drank it out of respect.

Wang Shuo toasted with everyone in turn and chatted with them, and the effect was very obvious.

Loyalty rose quickly, basically around 80.

Because Wang Shuo met their basic security needs.

The vast majority of these people did not have the ambition to establish a power. As long as they could guarantee safety and have food to eat, they would be very satisfied.

After all, the novice trials in the previous 20 days had made them suffer enough.

After eating, Wang Shuo was planning to build some houses for them. At this time, he found that some functions of the system could no longer be used normally.

This made Wang Shuo a little flustered.

He quickly checked the system prompt panel.

He found that when Wang Shuo was not paying attention, there were several prompts:

[1. The system transaction function is closed. Players must trade in the system town or trade face to face. ]

[2. The system automatic construction function is partially shut down. The specific situation requires players to explore it themselves. ]

[The chat channel of Dahuai District is established, divided by town areas, and refugee players automatically join. ]

[3. The ranking function is enabled. For specific situations, please explore it yourself. ]

Wang Shuo quickly checked the [chat channel].

He found that there are two channels, [Changping County Lord Channel] and [Hedong County Channel].

There are only more than 20 people in the Changping County Lord Channel, and the current number of people in the Hedong County Channel is 300,000.

Wang Shuo immediately opened the map and zoomed in. He found a Hedong County marked in the vast gray area, as well as Qinghe Town, Nanshanji, Xiaochi Town, Scarborough Market, Luohe County, Changping County and other place names.

The closest to Wang Shuo are Nanshanji and Qinghe Town. The nearest counties to these two towns are Changping County and Luohe County.

As for the ranking function, there are currently several lists, but there are no players on the list. It is shown that the list will be announced in 3 days.

Seeing such a change, Wang Shuo quickly asked Chang Gui.

Chang Gui was not surprised, but the situation was urgent before, so he did not mention it too much. Chang Gui also added that the system backpack will also be cancelled, and players can only use backpacks made or purchased by themselves at that time.

It seems that the current situation is indeed very different from before, and it is changing at any time.

It is equivalent to a system upgrade.

From version 1.0 to version 2.0, many functions have been modified.

Wang Shuo shared this information with his subjects, and then said: "At present, it seems that the houses you live in need to be built by yourself."

Wang Shuo divided everyone into two groups according to their living occupations and skills, one is the craftsman group and the other is the preparatory group.

Among these people, there are two who are the same profession as Wang Shuo, bricklayers, two carpenters, and three woodcutters. Wang Shuo put the five of them into the craftsman group to prepare to build houses, and put the other players into the reserve group to temporarily do odd jobs.

At the same time, the two most loyal people in these two groups, Suo Yong and Hua Tianxiong, were selected as team leaders to be responsible for the work of the two groups respectively.

After the work was arranged properly, Wang Shuo took out some resources and gave them to the two people, and took everyone to the open space between the inner and outer walls of the territory, located in the south, and guided everyone to start building houses.

Then, he called Guliji to the hall of the courtyard alone.
